Terms of Service

Last updated: November 11, 2026

These terms are an agreement between you and Regan.Studio (“Regan.Studio,” “we,” or “us”) for your use of the WhatEverFi service that we host, the WhatEverFi web, desktop, and mobile apps, and whateverfi.com (together, the “Service”). By using the Service, you agree to these terms. If you use the Service on behalf of an organization, you confirm that you can bind that organization to these terms, and “you” includes it.

Open-source software

The WhatEverFi source code is available under the Apache License 2.0. That license, not these terms, governs your use of the code. It does not grant rights to the WhatEverFi name or logo; do not use them in a way that suggests we operate or endorse something we do not. A third party that operates a self-hosted WhatEverFi deployment is responsible for that deployment and its own terms.

Your account

You must be at least 13 years old, and old enough to form a binding contract where you live, to use the Service. You may not use the Service if you are barred from doing so under US sanctions or export laws. Keep your sign-in details and connected credentials secure. You are responsible for activity in your account.

Bots and AI output

Bots act with the instructions, permissions, and connected accounts you give them, including when you are not watching, such as in scheduled routines. Actions your bots take, such as sending messages, changing data, making purchases, or running commands, are taken on your behalf and are your responsibility. Give bots only the access they need, and require approval for actions that are hard to undo.

AI output can be inaccurate or incomplete. Review it before you rely on it. Do not use the Service where an error could cause death, injury, or serious harm, or to make decisions with legal, medical, or financial consequences for others without qualified human review.

Acceptable use

You may not use the Service, or direct a bot, to:

  • Break the law or infringe the rights of others.
  • Send spam, distribute malware, or commit fraud.
  • Access systems, accounts, or data you are not authorized to access.
  • Interfere with the Service, circumvent its limits, or use its computers for cryptocurrency mining or attacks on other systems.
  • Violate the terms of the model providers or connected apps you use through the Service.
  • Create accounts by automated means or to evade limits, or resell or provide the hosted Service to others without our written permission.

Your content

You keep ownership of the content you provide and the output your bots produce, and you are responsible for having the rights to provide it. You give us permission to host, process, and transmit that content only as needed to provide the Service, as described in our privacy policy. We may use aggregated or de-identified usage data to operate and improve the Service. If you send us feedback, we may use it without obligation to you. Keep your own copies of content that matters to you.

Third-party services

The Service can connect to model providers, voice and memory services, computer providers, and other apps you choose. Those services are governed by their own terms, and we are not responsible for them. You are responsible for fees they charge you, including usage your bots incur on your own API keys.

Paid plans and billing

Some features require a paid plan. Prices are shown before you subscribe. Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each billing period until you cancel, and we charge the payment method on file, which is processed by Stripe. Prices exclude taxes unless stated otherwise. If your plan starts with a free trial, we collect a payment method at signup and charge it when the trial ends unless you cancel before then. Cancelling during the trial ends it, and you are not charged. Plans are subject to the fair use limits below. If a payment fails, we may pause paid features until it succeeds. If you dispute a charge with your bank instead of contacting us, we may suspend the account while the dispute is open. We will notify you before a price change takes effect on your next renewal, and you can cancel before it does.

Fair use

Hosted plans include the computer-hours a month listed for your plan on thepricing page, and up to 5 computers running at once per account. A computer counts toward those hours only while it is running. Computers sleep after a few minutes without activity and run for up to about two hours each time they wake, so they are not meant to stay on continuously. Each computer has the vCPUs and memory listed for your plan, and at least 50 GB of disk. Files are saved when a computer sleeps, up to 5 GB per computer, and kept until you delete the bot or your account. Rebuildable caches and dependencies are not kept.

If an account goes beyond these limits or places an unreasonable load on the Service, we may slow or pause its computers and will contact you before taking further action. We do not charge for computer use beyond your plan. These limits do not apply to self-hosted WhatEverFi.

Cancellation and refunds

You can cancel at any time from your account’s billing settings or by emailing hello@whateverfi.com. Cancellation stops future renewals; you keep access until the end of the period you paid for. Payments are non-refundable and partial periods are not prorated, except where required by law. Credits, including top-ups, are used up by the work your bots do, whatever its outcome, and used credits are not refunded.

If you are a consumer in the European Union or the United Kingdom, you can withdraw from a new subscription within 14 days of buying it by telling us, for example by email. Because you ask the Service to start immediately, we will refund your payment less an amount proportionate to the Service provided before you withdrew. For credits, that means we refund the credits you have not used.

Changes to the Service

We may add, change, or remove features. Features marked as beta or preview may be incomplete or change without notice, and we do not promise the Service will be uninterrupted or error-free. If we materially reduce a paid feature during your billing period, we will tell you in advance, and you can cancel and receive a refund for the unused period.

Termination

You can stop using the Service and delete your account at any time. We may suspend or terminate your access if you violate these terms, do not pay, or put the Service or others at risk, or if the law requires it. Where reasonable, we will tell you first. If we terminate your account or stop offering the Service for reasons other than a violation of these terms, we will give you reasonable notice and refund any prepaid fees for the unused period.

When an account is deleted, its bots and routines stop and we delete its content as described in our privacy policy, so save anything you want to keep first. Terms that by their nature should survive termination, such as fees owed, disclaimers, limits of liability, and indemnity, continue to apply.
